subject: [PATCH v3 05/12] nfsd: set ctime when a SETATTR with delegated times changes other attributes

2026-11-24.patch_summary: This patch fixes an issue where the ctime of a file was not being updated when a SETATTR request with delegated times changed other attributes. The patch adds ATTR_CTIME to the iattr structure unless the request is a delegated atime-only update, ensuring that ctime is updated whenever any attribute changes occur. Additionally, if a delegated mtime fails vetting, ctime will be moved to the current time instead of leaving it unchanged.
